findings.reason: a node that counts every `_store_persisted` call in the pass writes a test whose bound of one cannot pass even with the repair, so the section can be blocked on an instrument the plan did not pin down.
findings.text: the done-when bounds `_store_persisted` calls "from the discovery pass" at one, but that pass contains a store write that is not `record_discovery`'s flush; measured on a 25-plan temporary tree, one first read over an empty store makes 26 `_store_persisted` calls — 25 from `record_discovery` plus one from `_record_covered_shape` (reckon/metadata_index.py:607, reached through `metadata_index._covered_files` from `serve._walk_discovery_signature` inside the same pass), which the repair does not remove

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `metadata_index.record_discovery` (reckon/metadata_index.py:818), `_store_persisted` (1046), `_store.write_json_atomically` (reckon/_store.py:531, which calls `json.dump`) and the cited caller `serve._discover_plans_uncached` at `reckon/serve.py:2309` all resolve, and §25's evidence run `r-20261017T071731409931-the-store-build-excess-is-attributed` exists under the crew reports root.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the count bound does not say whether it includes the store write the index build itself makes inside the same first read.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the report and gate logs sit under the run directory, and the test under `tests/`, both durable and reachable by a later reader.

rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the named root cause matches the cited §25 evidence and was reproduced here: on a 25-plan tree a first read over an empty store calls `record_discovery` once per document (25 calls) and `_store_persisted` once per document plus one, each loading and rewriting the whole store, with the caller named at `reckon/serve.py:2309`.
